import tomlkit


def test_missing_newline_after_inline_table():
    """
    Test that a newline is inserted after an inline table when a new key is added.
    """
    v = tomlkit.loads("""[x]\na.b = {}""")
    v["x"]["c"] = 3
    expected_output = """[x]
a.b = {}
c = 3
"""
    assert tomlkit.dumps(v) == expected_output
